name: tpot
note: TPOT (tpot.cc), derived from the real site, not invented. tpot ships BOTH modes (footer toggle, persisted as localStorage theme=light|dark); this theme is its LIGHT mode, whose values are the site's own resolved tokens, not an inversion of the dark one: --background #ffffff, --foreground #101924, --muted #f4f7fa, --muted-foreground #5d6775, --border #e2e6eb, --primary #0093eb, --accent (soft pill fill) #e6f2fb. CONTRAST WARNING: #0093eb on white is only 3.28:1: it clears AA for LARGE text (>=24px) and UI fills but NOT for body copy, so blue is display-size or a fill only; fine print uses #5d6775 (5.64:1). Faces are REAL: Manrope 600 headline at -2px tracking (measured, do NOT default to 800) + Fraunces serif for numerals (the event-date '15'/'2'/'10') + JetBrains Mono for letterspaced eyebrows ('RECAPPING TPOT'). Flat field, zero texture: the page is plain white, so bgDefault is `plain` (MISTAKES.md #2). Captured components MUST be captured with LS="theme=light" or they bake dark surfaces.
